scope:
Measure the rejected original v46 on every balanced training factorial cell.

No fitting, threshold selection, new development/final data, audio hardware or
board access. Full classifier inputs are retained, without temporal pooling.
weighting: Mean of defined windows within each ID/speed/phrase/arm comparison; mean three speed means within ID, then equal conditioning IDs. Undefined metric counts and partial groups retained; no confidence intervals.
metric_direction: Nuisance left=quiet/right=other arm; near-word left=Hey Nyx/right=near word. logit_delta is right minus left, not a recognition event.

original_saved_model_preflight.limits: Finite first-ID/three-speed/four-phrase/five-arm preflight, not universal export equivalence. Current received SavedModel hashes are reported; historical export record did not bind these per-file hashes.

limits: Frozen selected10000 v46 original weights; training-only conditioning grid already examined. No generalization, independent-speaker or causal explanation of development errors.
Quiet/noise/RIR/combined conditions retain original gains, noise and tails. Common absolute positions avoid selecting different peaks; this does not isolate every rendering factor.
Complete generated containers and stored source boundaries are not verified phonetic endpoints.
The 300-dimensional Dense input retains five ordered positions. No extra embedding loss, temporal reduction, fitting, threshold choice or INT8/new-development/final/P4/audio operation.
Local clean upstream bytes are authenticated. GPU historical upstream bytes require a separate receipt; any finite original-export preflight is reported at its actual scope.
